description: Spatial zone definitions for all IKEA label families. Zones are named semantic regions read left-to-right in landscape orientation. Width ranges are approximate based on PDF observation.

zones.description: Leftmost zone containing core product identity: product name, article number, article code, and IKEA logo. This zone defines the label's brand and product identity.
zones.notes: In 1R20-PRADM the IKEA logo may appear in a dedicated left strip below the identity text. Colour dot only present in v3 variants.

zones.description: Contains the DataMatrix barcode block including human-readable AI application identifier lines below or beside the matrix symbol.
zones.notes: DataMatrix physical size depends on x-dimension (0.4, 0.5, 0.75mm) and symbol configuration (16x48 or 18x50 for rectangular; 26x26 or 28x28 for square). See shared_specs/barcode_specs.json.

zones.description: Contains the IKEA corporate address block, copyright notice, IKEA.com URL, and the country-of-origin/assembly text.
zones.notes: Origin text may appear above or below the address block depending on space. 1R20-PRADM has more address lines (adds AI fields, date, PI number).

zones.description: Column of legal/compliance symbol cells (e.g. regulatory marks). Cells are rotated 90° CW in v4 and v5 variants so the symbols read from bottom to top when the label is held landscape.
zones.notes: Only present in v4 and v5 variants. Number of symbol cells not fully legible from available PDF resolution — see open_questions.json OQ-002.

zones.description: US EPA TSCA title VI / ULEF compliance text block. In 1R10-PRADM v2 this is horizontal multi-column text. In 1R20-PRADM variants the entire block is rotated 90° CW.
zones.notes: 1R10-PRADM v2 compliance block is horizontal; 1R20-PRADM all compliance blocks are rotated 90° CW.

zones.description: Contains the patents reference URL (www.IKEA.com/patents) and the 'Patents:' label. Placement and orientation match the compliance block in the same variant.
zones.notes: Orientation mirrors compliance_block orientation in same variant.

zones.description: Contains the DATE: label, YYWW value, optional ABCD alpha block, and optional numeric suffix (1234). Default section width is 7mm (1R10) or 5mm (1R20) when date is absent/vertical. Grows to 22.5mm and rotates to horizontal when DATE is present.
zones.notes: Width and orientation are conditional — see family rules 1R10-PRADM-R001/R002/R003 and 1R20-PRADM-R001/R002/R003 for grow-rotate-reposition behaviour.

zones.description: Narrow vertical strip on the far right containing a single-digit or multi-digit copy count number. Digit is large and rotated 90° CW.
zones.notes: In v1 and v3 this is the rightmost element. In v5 it shares the far-right strip area with the date strip.

zones.description: Far right vertical strip in v4/v5 variants that combines the ABCD-YYWW-1234 date identifier block and optionally the copy count. All content is rotated 90° CW, reading bottom-to-top.
zones.notes: Stacking order of date strip vs copy count within this zone needs higher-res confirmation — see open_questions.json OQ-006.

notes: Not all zones are present in every variant. Zone presence is determined by the template variant's elements list and rules.
